conditions.title: Estate Expansion
conditions.statement: QUALIFIED under the development policy: the reported network moved from 872 to 952 across three annual snapshots.
conditions.change: Three consistent annual snapshots; two intervals; cumulative movement 9.17% exceeds the unchanged 5% estate-expansion development threshold.

comparisons.metric: Net change in a consistently scoped physical-location estate over one annual reporting period.
comparisons.peer_set_or_history: UK or UK & Ireland trade-oriented retail-style counter networks providing tools, decorating or building supplies through consistently counted customer-facing branches/stores.
caveats: Rank is descriptive, not a robust population percentile.
The cohort is development-small and is not a population sample.
Selco and Leyland SDM share Grafton Group ownership, so those rows are not fully independent strategic decision-makers.
Screwfix includes Ireland while the other included rows are UK or Great Britain; the geographic basis is stable within the annual bridge but remains a caveat.
The feature describes estate direction only and does not establish health, productivity or success.
comparisons.comparison_window: FY2025 annual windows ending between 27 December 2025 and 31 January 2026
comparisons.cohort_definition: UK or UK & Ireland trade-oriented retail-style counter networks providing tools, decorating or building supplies through consistently counted customer-facing branches/stores.
cohort_exclusions: B&Q UK & Ireland: Consumer-led big-box/compact retail purpose is not the selected trade-oriented retail-counter operating format.
Wickes UK: The audited source set does not provide a sufficiently explicit, reconciled FY2025 ending count on the same basis; openings are not used to infer it.
Howdens UK: Order-led kitchen depot purpose and account relationship are not the selected retail-style tools/building-supplies counter format.
Woodie's Ireland: Geography and consumer-led format are outside the selected cohort; no comparable starting bridge is retained.
